item.title: Gas price surge over Iran hits Americans already struggling with affordability
item.description: High fuel prices caused by the conflict in Iran threaten to worsen affordability issues that ordinary Americans face — and some economists are warning that a prolonged conflict could pull the U.S. into a recession. Oil prices have jumped in the wake of U.S. attacks on Iran. International benchmark Brent crude was trading at about $101 dollars [...]

item.title: Ex-NFL player charged with murder asked ChatGPT for advice before 911 call, prosecutors say
item.description: Darron Lee, who spent five seasons in the NFL, faces charges of first-degree murder and tampering with evidence in the death of his girlfriend.

item.title: Houston police seek suspect in teen shooting
item.description: A 17-year-old was shot in the back while walking down a street in Houston and police are searching for the suspect.

item.title: Sunshine and cooler conditions today, gradual warmup over the weekend
item.description: The severe weather threat has not completely disappeared, but the bigger concern heading into Sunday is locally heavy rainfall.

item.title: Round Rock mayoral candidate wins Texas House primary he didn’t know he was in
item.description: A candidate for a Texas House seat won last week’s Democratic primary, without realizing he was still on the ballot. He also is running for Mayor of Round Rock at the same time.

item.title: NASA clears Artemis II rocket to the moon for April launch
item.description: NASA reviews its readiness to launch four astronauts around the moon after fixing the latest rocket problem that forced a return to the hangar and bumped the mission into April.

item.title: Trial of Fort Bend County Judge KP George begins with opening statements
item.description: Prosecutors told jurors they expect the evidence to ultimately prove that KP George committed money laundering.

item.title: Gunman in Old Dominion University shooting served time for ISIS support, officials report
item.description: One person was killed and two others were hurt in a shooting at Old Dominion University on Thursday morning, according to officials at the Virginia school. The suspected gunman is also dead, the officials said.

item.title: Man who rammed his vehicle into Michigan synagogue was naturalized citizen from Lebanon, DHS says
item.description: An attacker armed with a rifle rammed his vehicle into one of the nation’s largest reform synagogues Thursday, driving through a hallway as security opened fire, fatally shooting him, authorities said.

item.title: Rodeo revokes ex-officio status to Harris County Judge Lina Hidalgo in concert controversy
item.description: Officials from the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo responded to Harris County Judge Lina Hidalgo's accusation that she was removed from Tuesday's concert after attempting to bring guests into an area inside NRG Stadium.
